title: Servex is live: one process, eleven tools

text: Running now under a keeper (back in 3 s if killed). Proxy 8080, dashboard 8090, one /mcp door with six server tools and five agent tools; Claude sessions held in memory, steerable mid-run, tokens streaming on the dashboard. Phase 1 of your brief is done. Left for you: a logon task so it survives a reboot.
